image_description: A close-up photograph of a small passerine bird, identified as a female or non-breeding male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), perched on a thin, light-colored branch. The bird has a brownish-grey head with a pale supercilium, a dark eye, and a short, conical bill. Its breast is buff-orange, fading into a lighter underbelly. The upperparts are streaked brown and grey, with visible white wing bars on the folded wings. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting foliage.
